newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealanders made more overseas trips in May - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: New Zealanders made more overseas trips in May - SNZ.

text.p: New Zealand residents left for 89,260 short trips overseas in May, 11.0 percent more than in May 1996, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
During May there was also a net outflow of 1,240 permanent and long-term migrants compared with a net gain of 620 a year earlier.
"The net gain for the year to May 1997 was 17,500, down 42 percent on the May 1996 year net gain of 30,110," SNZ added.
At the same time, adjusted for seasonal variations, overseas visitor arrivals increased by six percent between April and May this year. This followed a six percent drop between March and April.
In absolute terms, overseas vistor arrivals in the month of May of 87,800 were up 1.0 percent on a year-on-year basis.
In the year to end May the total was 1.546 million, up 6.0 percent on the previous May year total.
